sentences.en: I spent the best part of the day in reading.
sentences.zh: 我花了大半天的时间阅读。

sentences.en: The man reading a paper over there is my uncle.
sentences.zh: 那边正在读报纸的是我的叔叔。

sentences.en: Please return the book when you have finished reading it.
sentences.zh: 看完这本书后请还给我。

senses.zh: 阅读；读物；读数，指数；朗读；朗诵
